title: Performance
description: Optimize your GraphQL API with DataLoader, caching, and persisted queries.
longDescription: Performance is what separates a demo from a production API. This module covers DataLoader for eliminating N+1 queries, field and query caching, query complexity analysis to prevent abuse, and persisted queries for bandwidth optimization.
whatYouLearn: How to identify and fix the N+1 problem
How to use DataLoader for batch loading
How to cache query and field results
How to limit query complexity and use persisted queries
